attractions.name: Akihabara
attractions.description: A major district for anime, manga, gaming, electronics, and tech culture.

attractions.name: Shibuya Crossing
attractions.description: One of Tokyo's most famous urban landmarks.

attractions.name: teamLab Planets
attractions.description: Immersive digital art museum using lights, projections, and interactive installations.

attractions.name: Ghibli Museum
attractions.description: Museum dedicated to Studio Ghibli animation and creative storytelling.

attractions.name: Tsukiji Outer Market
attractions.description: Popular food market with sushi, seafood, snacks, and street food.

attractions.name: Fushimi Inari Shrine
attractions.description: Famous shrine known for thousands of red torii gates.

attractions.name: Arashiyama Bamboo Forest
attractions.description: Scenic bamboo grove and one of Kyoto's most visited places.

attractions.name: Nishiki Market
attractions.description: Traditional market known for Kyoto snacks and local food.

attractions.name: Dotonbori
attractions.description: Famous area for street food, neon lights, and entertainment.

attractions.name: Universal Studios Japan
attractions.description: Large theme park with rides, shows, and pop-culture attractions.

travel_tips: Use public transport inside major cities.
Reserve popular museums and themed attractions in advance.
For a 7-day trip, Tokyo + Kyoto or Tokyo + Osaka is more realistic than visiting too many cities.
